lines.en: …and let us know whether or not you've changed your mind

lines.ko: 기능획득 연구의 이득이 위험보다 크다는 생각 말입니다.
lines.en: on whether or not the benefits of gain-of-function research outweigh the risks.

lines.ko: 변호인의 조언에 따라 답변을 정중히 거부합니다.
lines.en: On the advice of counsel, I respectfully decline to answer

lines.ko: 수정헌법 제5조에 따른 제 권리에 근거해서요.
lines.en: based upon my rights under the Fifth Amendment to the Constitution.
You're not recognized. You're not recognized.
If you are unruly, you will be removed from the proceeding.
You are not recognized. And you are not recognized, sir.

lines.ko: 위원장님, 변호인 얘기를 들어 보고 싶은데요.
lines.en: So, Mr. Chairman, I'd like to hear what the attorney has to say.
He is not recognized by the committee or the chair.

lines.ko: 한 번 더 말하면 회의장에서 내보냅니다.
lines.en: If he speaks again, he will be removed from the room.
Security, please remove him from the room.

lines.ko: 기록해 두죠. 파우치 박사는 계속 조언을 받을 수 있습니다.
lines.en: Let the record state that Dr. Fauci will still have the advice

lines.ko: 오늘 데려온 나머지 변호사 대여섯 명한테서요.
lines.en: of the other half a dozen attorneys that he brought along today.
